title: The only one habit application that you need.
body:
Trust me, I’ve tried literally all, yes, all of the habit trackers on the entire iOS store. 

Some are better, others so so, but none of them made me stick with the application. 

This one is simple, efficient, extremely cute, smartly well designed with the just needed features without being boring or plain. No bs features, nor strange function’s that none uses nor add any benefit in your habit making battle. 

This simple works, the price is just right, the data that throws you are informative enough and it’s so cute that you want to come back to keep accumulating reps and unlocking those achievements. 

So guys, give it a go! And remember, forget about your goals, just focus on your system, keep persevering and accumulating the evidence you need to build you identity. 

Keep it strong, Godspeed !
author: Bananaorcoffee
